worldcombat.skill.bide.summary: Holds an endurance stance, recording every incoming hit on a ledger; when it ends the damage is paid back at 1.4x-2.8x to whoever hit last, or to the nearest enemy if out of reach; an empty ledger or an interruption returns nothing.
worldcombat.skill.bide.use.0: Bank one big payback during a beating
worldcombat.skill.bide.use.1: Make the foe decide whether to keep hitting a rooted target
worldcombat.skill.bide.use.2: Gather scattered chip damage into one heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.bide.description.0: Enter an endurance stance for %1$s, storing incoming damage. At the end, return it amplified by current health and stance; the current estimate is %2$s damage. Lower remaining health increases the return.
worldcombat.skill.bide.description.1: The ledger caps at %1$s of the user's maximum health; the payback reaches the last attacker within %2$s blocks, or the nearest enemy if that one is out of reach.
worldcombat.skill.bide.description.2: Prepare %1$s s, recover %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bide.rooted.on: Rooted endurance: the stance lasts x1.15 and the payback multiplier is x1.1, but the user cannot move for the whole stance.
worldcombat.skill.bide.rooted.off: Mobile endurance: the user may reposition, at the cost of a x0.8 stance and a x0.9 payback multiplier.
worldcombat.skill.bide.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.bide.preference.rooted: On: the stance lasts longer and pays back harder, but the user cannot move for its whole duration (rooted in place). Off: endure while moving, at the cost of a shorter window and a lighter payback.
worldcombat.skill.bide.preference.ai.min: The stance is only opened above this health ratio. Higher is more conservative and may stand and take hits at full health; lower saves it, but a low-health user might fall before the ledger is settled.
worldcombat.skill.bide.description.relea: An interruption collapses the stance and voids the ledger; an empty ledger, or a payback that reaches no enemy, whiffs. No new move can be started before the stance ends.
